common: Vertical smartphone UGC beauty shorts frame, photorealistic, the same Korean woman in her 20s with light brown hair in a low ponytail with face-framing strands. Soft natural daylight, real skin texture with visible pores, no beauty filter. Keep the upper third of the frame clean for subtitles. Any serum bottle is a plain unlabeled clear glass dropper bottle with light aqua serum. No text, no logos, no watermark.

looks.bare: Completely bare face, no makeup at all, natural brows, natural lip color.
looks.makeup: Natural glowy K-beauty makeup: thin skin-like foundation, soft brown eyeliner, light peach blush, sheer coral-rose lip tint.

scenes.shot: Close-up in front of a bathroom mirror, she gently taps her cheek with one fingertip, mildly frustrated relatable expression; the cheek skin looks a little dry and flaky. White tiled bathroom softly blurred. Wearing a plain white t-shirt.
Medium close-up at a bright vanity, she holds a small unopened skincare box and the serum bottle toward the camera, label side facing the lens, curious smile. Wearing a plain white t-shirt.
Macro close-up of her hand: the dropper releases a drop of serum onto the back of her hand, glossy droplet, her face softly out of focus in the background.
After face washing with a hair band on, she presses both palms gently on her cheeks to pat in serum, eyes closed, calm expression, bathroom background.
Close-up of her cheek in the same bathroom lighting, smooth hydrated skin with a soft natural sheen, she glances at the mirror with a satisfied small smile.
She holds the serum bottle next to her face at chest height and points down with her other hand, friendly smile toward the camera, clean bright room background.
Extreme macro: a single drop of light aqua serum falling from the glass dropper in slow motion, her blurred face in the background.
Macro close-up of the back of her hand as two fingers spread a thin layer of serum, watery texture spreading, her face softly blurred behind.
Close-up of the back of her hand tilted sideways showing the absorbed serum not dripping, she lightly taps it with a fingertip.
Tight close-up of her cheek right after applying serum, dewy hydrated skin catching window light, eyes looking slightly off camera.
Front-facing product shot: she holds the serum bottle at eye level beside her face, soft smile, warm clean background.
Day 1 diary-style close-up portrait facing the camera directly, neutral expression, plain light wall background, even soft light.
Morning routine moment: she drips two or three drops of serum into her palm in front of the bathroom mirror, casual home outfit.
Day 7 close-up portrait in the exact same framing, wall and lighting as Day 1, relaxed comfortable expression, skin looks comfortable and hydrated.
She holds the serum bottle up next to her face and smiles at the camera, plain light wall background.
